newsitem.title: USA: AMBAC qualifies seven issues for bond insurance.
newsitem.headline: AMBAC qualifies seven issues for bond insurance.

text.p: AMBAC Indemnity Corp said it has qualified for bond insurance the following seven municipal issues scheduled for competitive sale today.
--Cedar Falls, Iowa, $3.5 million and $4.5 million corporate purpose bonds.
--Randolph CSD, N.Y., $2.77 million school district bonds.
--Salmon River CSD, N.Y., $2.63 million school district bonds.
--Hewitt, Texas, $1 million tax and revenue certificates.
--Montgomery County, Texas, $4.625 million certificates of obligation.
--Sachse, Texas, $1.14 million tax and revenue certificates.
